svg.title: My ninja way
svg.desc: Aditya stands with Naruto beside three things he builds: living interfaces, motion with a story arc, and clean enterprise data flows.

g.text: Software builder & CS student: diving deep into DSA, ML and Security.
Optimized data structures and problem solving in C++, Java and Python
Intelligent data-driven models, automated agents and ML workflows
Robust SQL databases, clean data flows and cybersecurity principles
“I don't watch anime. I code anime.”
